Events in this area can be done in any order. They won't cause time to pass, but will increase your stress. Return home via the Expeditions depot flag, or the Home button at the top-left of the screen.\n\nWatch for collectible items you can bring back as gifts! Events respawn at the beginning of each year, and new collectibles have a chance to appear every season.
When you work or go to class, you'll play a quick card challenge as the month passes. Move cards to fill the 5 panes and make the best hand you can. Yes, order matters...
If your total in the circle on the right reaches the goal value, you win.\n\nDepending on your cards, some challenges can't be won, but you still get a reward for doing your best.
Bonus for straights (increasing from left to right):
The more cards in a flush, pair, or straight, the higher the bonus added to your total. Cards can also affect each other, and can be rearranged to find the best total score.
Looking for more difficulty? This Harder Card Challenges option will keep you on your toes.
Want to focus on the story? This will replace future minigames with a quick coin flip based on your age and skills. You can change either option any time from the settings menu.

Story challenges have three rounds instead of one. After every round, you'll keep the cards you didn't play, and unlock an extra slot to play them in. Losing isn't always a bad thing in story challenges!

As you get older, challenges can have conditions. The challenge suit (social, mental, or physical) determines what conditions can appear, and which decks will work best.\n\nTry to collect social (yellow) cards if you want to win battles for social skills (empathy, persuasion, creativity, bravery).

Your skills increase when you work or go to school, with extra skills if you win the challenge, and a kudos bonus if you make the highest scoring hand with your cards.\n\nWorking also increases stress, which prevents you from working if it reaches 100. To relieve stress, take a month off to relax in the quarters wing.

Childhood is fleeting! The game will end when you reach age 20, so you should focus on a few skills to improve and friends to spend time with. Use the Skills and Friends buttons at the top-left of the screen to keep track of them. Good luck!
